build_cls_pooler: build a ClsPooler to extract the classification token from a transformer hidden state tensor
create_mean_pooler: create a MeanPooler to compute the average feature across a sequence dimension of hidden states
test_average_concat_last_k: test the AverageConcatLastN pooler by concatenating the last k encoder layers and applying padding mask
review_average_k_from_last: review the AverageKFromLast pooler to select and average the k-th to last encoder layer with padding
refactor_average_sum_last_k: refactor the AverageSumLastK pooler to sum the last k encoder layers before applying padding mask pooling
